findings.finding: The loaded fixture polluted the global native assembly inventory during parallel execution.
findings.resolution: The same replacement control now loads System.Text.Json and replaces it with System.Linq; both identities are excluded by native inventory filtering.

findings.finding: A staging command exiting before an output-holding descendant left the orphan alive.
findings.evidence: Reviewer reflection control with an early-exiting shell retained an orphan after 10.4 seconds.
findings.resolution: Reuse the existing exclusive PackageTestProcessSupervisor, retaining ownership until descendants terminate and are reaped. The additional real detached-child/parent-exit control passes.

findings.finding: Cleanup timeout could masquerade as expected caller cancellation.
findings.resolution: Convert cleanup deadline cancellation to TimeoutException and assert the cancellation exception carries the exact caller token.

findings.finding: Normal process reaping could remove /proc metadata between existence check and read.
findings.resolution: Read directly and accept FileNotFoundException/DirectoryNotFoundException. The supervisor owns and reaps the real staging child.

followup: Static recheck found no remaining confirmed defects in the three C# files. Final rebuilt native and staging controls pass.
